overview.description: The FT Vest NVDA & Target Income ETF (XVNV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF seeking monthly income of approximately 15%, before fees and expenses, above the S&P 500 forward dividend yield, through a multi-layered options strategy built around NVIDIA Corporation stock, while maintaining partial participation in NVIDIAs price appreciation. XVNV was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
